item.title: What is body doubling, and does it work for studying?
item.description: Body doubling means doing your work while someone else is present. Here is why it helps people start and keep studying, who it works for, and how to try it tonight, even alone.

item.title: How to stop checking your phone while studying
item.description: Why you keep picking up your phone while studying, what the research says about phones and focus, and simple changes that actually work, from distance to timers to a study buddy.

item.title: How to actually remember what you study (without making flashcards)
item.description: Why you forget what you studied last week, and the two methods with the strongest research behind them: active recall and spaced repetition. Plus how to use them without building an Anki deck.
